title: Response sheet
summary: SHEET 12/14 turns the FAQ into a document sheet. An index of six bordered question cells sits beside a response cell and a spec cell of mono keys with chips, so each answer reads like a spec sheet rather than an accordion. The selected cell inverts, a 1px red datum leader routes from it to its 'Q-0n · RESPONSE' head, and a bottom row of cells closes the sheet with both doors and a cross-reference to the sheet that proves the answer.

reference.borrowed: A master–detail plate inside a visibly framed page, with margin verticals and section hairlines drawn. On the left, a stack of bordered one-line list cells each carries a →, with the active one highlighted. On the right, a detail panel holds a solid action button, a short paragraph and mono key rows ('OPEN SOURCE', 'PRIMITIVES') whose values are bordered chips, with active chips inverted. Selection lives in an index, and the answer reads like a spec.
reference.kelwin: Browserbase's frame became C's drawing sheet: margin verticals, the opening hairline, four chosen crosshairs, cell borders only where cells exist, and a legend and title-block band (SHEET 12/14 · REV C · SCALE 1:1 · mark). The centred heading became the title cell in cols 1–9: the red-square mono 'SHEET 12/14 · QUESTIONS', then 'STRAIGHT / ANSWERS / BEFORE THE CALL.' in 88px caps with the turn dropping to --fg-3, then the 48×2 red rule. A 22px light note cell in cols 10–12 sits on the same column line as the spec cell below. The list cells became six 64px Q-01–Q-06 cells, and the active one inverts as C's tabs do. The detail panel split into a response cell (an uppercase topic plus the full answer) and a spec cell that keeps Browserbase's key-row-plus-chip grammar. Every value comes from the FAQ copy, e.g. FORMAT [FIXED-SCOPE DIAGNOSTIC], DURATION [10][WD], MAPS [NARRATIVE][CHANNELS][DATA] and READOUT [YOURS TO KEEP], inverted. The black 'Try template' button became the red audit cell 'INITIATE SYSTEM AUDIT ↗'. It shares the bottom row with the contact cell and a 'SEE ALSO' cell that cross-references the proving sheet (e.g. Sheet 08/14 · Method — PH.01 Diagnose).

motion: entrance, in drafting order: the frame verticals, sheet edge and crosshairs fade in (300ms), then the cell borders draw in raster order (440ms each, 40ms stagger). The red label square appears, the three title lines wipe in left to right (700ms, 100ms stagger) and the red rule draws under them (400ms). The note, the body heads and the index cells fade in raster order (60ms stagger), followed by the response, spec, door cells and title block.

selection (≈1.05s): Q-01 inverts (300ms). 'Q-01 · RESPONSE' and the topic type on at 24ms per character, the paragraph crossfades, and every spec chip types on (rows staggered 90ms) along with the cross-reference. The red datum leader then appears, drawing up from the cell's edge to the response head (500ms --ease-inout).

state change (the orchestrated moment, at 2.6s): the selection steps to Q-02. The inversion moves down a cell, and the leader re-routes as its origin square and stub slide down while the vertical lengthens (600ms --ease-inout). The head, topic, chips and 'SEE ALSO' value re-type for the System Audit, and the legend lifts 'Q-02 AUDIT' to --fg. It rests at about 3.6s.
ambient: none; this sheet carries no live readouts.

interaction: the index is a real vertical tablist (click, or ↑/↓). Hovering a question cell fills --panel and nudges its arrow, the contact and cross-reference cells invert on hover, and the audit cell deepens to --accent-hover.
on the live site: the selection follows click and keyboard (not scroll, which suits a FAQ), and the leader re-routes on every change. With reduced motion the fully drafted sheet shows Q-01 selected.
notes: Critique pass: the title row was brought to the founder's section-head spec (red-square sheet label, 88px caps title over three lines, 48×2 red rule), as the sibling C sheets were. The title/note split moved from col 8|9 to col 9|10 so the note cell stacks exactly over the spec cell, and the fourth crosshair moved off the red audit cell's corner to that junction. The sheet grows from 880 to 1024px. Sheet numbering matches the built C sheets (stack 04, method 08, fit 09, assets 10, before/after 11, CTA 13). Red appears as the founder's head furniture (label square, rule), the action cell and one datum leader. Paper is used because C puts documents on paper.
